opening.text: I'm here because my left hand has become weak and I can't use it as well as before. I've developed pain in my forearm, and I've completely lost the strength to bend my thumb and index finger. My fingers are numb, and my grip and pinch have become weak. I've also noticed that the fleshy part at the base of my left thumb has shrunk. This is all related to my cancer history; my left breast was removed, along with the lymph nodes in my armpit, and I also had radiotherapy for the cancer. I still take tamoxifen.
